references.text: Mikmetath is also mentioned here as a boundary marker for the tribe of Manasseh, which bordered on the territory of Ephraim.
Shiloh is mentioned as the place where the tabernacle was set up and is closely linked to Taanath-shiloh, which is noted in the boundary description.
Janah is mentioned as part of Naphtali's border and shows a geographical connection with the border cities in Canaan.
Janah in Ephraim is mentioned as one of the cities conquered by the king of Assyria, confirming the city's location in this area.
